name: astrapedia
description: An interactive 3D celestial sphere application for learning astronomical coordinates and finding celestial objects. Built with Three.js and real astronomical data.

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p www && cp app.html www/index.html && cp skymap.js main.js debug.js styles.css sw.js manifest.json favicon.svg icon-192.png icon-512.png www/ && cp -r modules www/ && cp -r data www/
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

author: Quentin Spinat
